_readme: Hand-kept inputs for scripts/fetch_cfb.mjs. dob: 'Name|School' (or just 'Name') -> YYYY-MM-DD, used for decimal age. players: 'Name|School' or 'Name' -> {fv: 55, plus: true, note: '...'}; a hand FV replaces the model's and shows a pencil mark on the board. School is the ESPN short name shown on the board (e.g. 'Ohio State', 'Miami').
